Below is an interactive clinical data explorer running directly in your browser via WebAssembly (Shinylive):

```{shinylive-r}
#| standalone: true
#| viewerHeight: 650
#| viewerWidth: 100%

library(shiny)

# 1. UI Definition
ui <- fluidPage(
  theme = bslib::bs_theme(bootswatch = "flatly"),
  titlePanel("CDISC ADSL Variable Explorer"),
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      selectInput("variable", "Select Demographic Metric:", 
                  choices = c("Age" = "AGE", "Baseline Height (cm)" = "HEIGHT", "Baseline Weight (kg)" = "WEIGHT")),
      sliderInput("bins", "Histogram Bins:", min = 5, max = 25, value = 12),
      checkboxInput("show_table", "Show Raw Data Table", value = TRUE)
    ),
    mainPanel(
      plotOutput("distPlot"),
      hr(),
      conditionalPanel(
        condition = "input.show_table == true",
        tableOutput("dataTable")
      )
    )
  )
)

# 2. Server Definition
server <- function(input, output, session) {
  # Synthetic ADSL Patient Data
  set.seed(42)
  adsl <- data.frame(
    USUBJID = paste0("PAT-", 101:120),
    AGE = round(rnorm(20, mean = 58, sd = 8)),
    HEIGHT = round(rnorm(20, mean = 168, sd = 10), 1),
    WEIGHT = round(rnorm(20, mean = 74, sd = 12), 1)
  )

  output$distPlot <- renderPlot({
    val <- adsl[[input$variable]]
    hist(val, breaks = input$bins, col = "#2c3e50", border = "white",
         xlab = input$variable, main = paste("Distribution of", input$variable))
  })

  output$dataTable <- renderTable({
    head(adsl[, c("USUBJID", input$variable)], 8)
  })
}

shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
```
